enum Status { Ok = 200, Created }
namespace Ui { export enum Status { Ok = "ok", Bad = "bad" } console.log(Status.Ok); }
enum Next { Z = Status.Ok }
console.log(Next.Z, Next[200], Status[201]);
function scoped() { enum Alpha { Ok = "text" } return Alpha.Ok; }
enum Alpha { Ok = 1 }
enum Beta { Pick = Alpha.Ok }
enum M { A = 1 }
enum M { B = A + 1 }
enum N { C = M.B, D }
console.log(Beta[1], scoped(), M[2], N[2], N[3]);
